assertions.sql: SELECT employee_id, employee_name, badge_id FROM employees NATURAL JOIN badges ORDER BY employee_id;
assertions.purpose: NATURAL JOINがemployee_idとstatusの両方を条件にして正当な2行を落とすことを再現する

assertions.sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, b.badge_id FROM employees AS e JOIN badges AS b ON b.employee_id=e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id;
assertions.purpose: 明示したキー結合が3件すべての従業員とバッジの対応を返すことを検証する

assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees NATURAL JOIN badges), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees AS e JOIN badges AS b ON b.employee_id=e.employee_id);
assertions.purpose: 暗黙の追加条件により結果が3件から1件へ欠落することを確認する

assertions.sql: SELECT e.employee_id FROM employees AS e JOIN badges AS b ON b.employee_id=e.employee_id WHERE e.status <> b.status ORDER BY e.employee_id;
assertions.purpose: 同名status列は異なる概念であり、不一致でもemployee_idの対応は有効だと示す
